name: no-id-in-logs
prompt: Compliance flagged that session ids must never appear in application logs. In main.go: add func logRequest(method, path string, status int, id string) that writes one line like method=POST path=/session status=200 id=[REDACTED] using the log package, where the id field is the literal [REDACTED] whenever id is non-empty and empty when it is empty. Wire it into sessionHandler for POST, GET, and DELETE (defer a call with the query id and a 200 status). No actual session id may ever appear in the log output.
check:
cat > probe_nolog_test.go <<'EOF'
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"log"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestProbeNoIDInLogs(t *testing.T) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	log.SetOutput(&buf)
	log.SetFlags(0)
	defer func() { log.SetOutput(nil); log.SetFlags(log.LstdFlags) }()

	store := NewStore(time.Minute)
	handler := sessionHandler(store)

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler(rec, httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/session?id=secret-id-9&user=alice", nil))
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler(rec, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/session?id=secret-id-9", nil))
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler(rec, httptest.NewRequest("DELETE", "/session?id=secret-id-9", nil))

	output := buf.String()
	if strings.Contains(output, "secret-id-9") {
		t.Fatalf("session id leaked into logs: %q", output)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(output, "REDACTED") {
		t.Fatalf("expected redaction marker in logs: %q", output)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(output, "method=POST") || !strings.Contains(output, "method=GET") || !strings.Contains(output, "method=DELETE") {
		t.Fatalf("expected request logs for all three branches: %q", output)
	}
}
EOF
go test -count=1 . ; rc=$? ; rm -f probe_nolog_test.go ; exit $rc
